title: The Apostle's Peace: Cosmic Letters Between the Heights and the Molded Man
description: The Apostle's customary opening of "peace and greeting" is read as the lowest-degree imprint of cosmic letters traveling between the Heights and the molded man: the Calling sent down from the Living Spirit, the answering Hearing carried up by the First Man's ascent inscribed with the wars and contests, and the Mind of Light from Christ as the apostolic letter into the regenerate human. Every divine influx and every soul's response is content "written down."
